spans.text: [1] AR: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ تَبَٰرَكَ ٱلَّذِى بِيَدِهِ ٱلْمُلْكُ وَهُوَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍۢ قَدِيرٌ EN: Blessed is He in whose hand is dominion, and He is over all things competent -

spans.text: [1] AR: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ تَبَٰرَكَ ٱلَّذِى بِيَدِهِ ٱلْمُلْكُ وَهُوَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍۢ قَدِيرٌ EN: Blessed is He in whose hand is dominion, and He is over all things competent -

entries.description: of you is best in deed - and He is the Exalted in Might
entries.subject: of you
entries.object: best in deed - and He is the Exalted in Might

spans.text: [2] AR: ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَ ٱلْمَوْتَ وَٱلْحَيَوٰةَ لِيَبْلُوَكُمْ أَيُّكُمْ أَحْسَنُ عَمَلًۭا ۚ وَهُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلْغَفُورُ EN: [He] who created death and life to test you [as to] which of you is best in deed - and He is the Exalted in Might, the Forgiving -

entries.task_id: while it|is|fatigued
entries.description: while it is fatigued
entries.subject: while it
entries.object: fatigued

spans.text: [Your] vision will return to you humbled while it is fatigued.

entries.task_id: them what|is|thrown at the devils and have prepared for them the punishment of the blaze
entries.description: them what is thrown at the devils and have prepared for them the punishment of the Blaze
entries.subject: them what
entries.object: thrown at the devils and have prepared for them the punishment of the Blaze

spans.text: [5] AR: وَلَقَدْ زَيَّنَّا ٱلسَّمَآءَ ٱلدُّنْيَا بِمَصَٰبِيحَ وَجَعَلْنَٰهَا رُجُومًۭا لِّلشَّيَٰطِينِ ۖ وَأَعْتَدْنَا لَهُمْ عَذَابَ ٱلسَّعِيرِ EN: And We have certainly beautified the nearest heaven with stars and have made [from] them what is thrown at the devils and have prepared for them the punishment of the Blaze.

entries.task_id: their lord|is|the punishment of hell
entries.description: their Lord is the punishment of Hell
entries.subject: their Lord
entries.object: the punishment of Hell

spans.text: [6] AR: وَلِلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ بِرَبِّهِمْ عَذَابُ جَهَنَّمَ ۖ وَبِئْسَ ٱلْمَصِيرُ EN: And for those who disbelieved in their Lord is the punishment of Hell, and wretched is the destination.

spans.text: [6] AR: وَلِلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ بِرَبِّهِمْ عَذَابُ جَهَنَّمَ ۖ وَبِئْسَ ٱلْمَصِيرُ EN: And for those who disbelieved in their Lord is the punishment of Hell, and wretched is the destination.

entries.description: a company is thrown into it
entries.subject: a company
entries.object: thrown into it

spans.text: Every time a company is thrown into it, its keepers ask them, "Did there not come to you a warner?"

entries.task_id: 'allah|has|not sent down anything
entries.description: 'Allah has not sent down anything
entries.subject: 'Allah
entries.object: not sent down anything

spans.text: [9] AR: قَالُوا۟ بَلَىٰ قَدْ جَآءَنَا نَذِيرٌۭ فَكَذَّبْنَا وَقُلْنَا مَا نَزَّلَ ٱللَّهُ مِن شَىْءٍ إِنْ أَنتُمْ إِلَّا فِى ضَلَٰلٍۢ كَبِيرٍۢ EN: They will say," Yes, a warner had come to us, but we denied and said, 'Allah has not sent down anything.

entries.task_id: their lord|unseen|will have forgiveness and great reward
entries.description: their Lord unseen will have forgiveness and great reward
entries.subject: their Lord
entries.object: will have forgiveness and great reward

spans.text: [12] AR: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ يَخْشَوْنَ رَبَّهُم بِٱلْغَيْبِ لَهُم مَّغْفِرَةٌۭ وَأَجْرٌۭ كَبِيرٌۭ EN: Indeed, those who fear their Lord unseen will have forgiveness and great reward.

entries.task_id: he|is|knowing of that within the breasts
entries.description: He is Knowing of that within the breasts
entries.subject: He
entries.object: Knowing of that within the breasts

spans.text: [13] AR: وَأَسِرُّوا۟ قَوْلَكُمْ أَوِ ٱجْهَرُوا۟ بِهِۦٓ ۖ إِنَّهُۥ عَلِيمٌۢ بِذَاتِ ٱلصُّدُورِ EN: And conceal your speech or publicize it; indeed, He is Knowing of that within the breasts.

entries.task_id: while he|is|the subtle
entries.description: while He is the Subtle
entries.subject: while He
entries.object: the Subtle

spans.text: [14] AR: أَلَا يَعْلَمُ مَنْ خَلَقَ وَهُوَ ٱللَّطِيفُ ٱلْخَبِيرُ EN: Does He who created not know, while He is the Subtle, the Acquainted?

entries.task_id: it|is|he who made the earth tame for you - so walk among its slopes and eat of his provision - and to him is the resurrection
entries.description: It is He who made the earth tame for you - so walk among its slopes and eat of His provision - and to Him is the resurrection
entries.subject: It
entries.object: He who made the earth tame for you - so walk among its slopes and eat of His provision - and to Him is the resurrection

spans.text: [15] AR: هُوَ ٱلَّذِى جَعَلَ لَكُمُ ٱلْأَرْضَ ذَلُولًۭا فَٱمْشُوا۟ فِى مَنَاكِبِهَا وَكُلُوا۟ مِن رِّزْقِهِۦ ۖ وَإِلَيْهِ ٱلنُّشُورُ EN: It is He who made the earth tame for you - so walk among its slopes and eat of His provision - and to Him is the resurrection.

entries.task_id: or who|is|it that could be an army for you to aid you other than the most merciful?
entries.description: Or who is it that could be an army for you to aid you other than the Most Merciful?
entries.subject: Or who
entries.object: it that could be an army for you to aid you other than the Most Merciful?

spans.text: [20] AR: أَمَّنْ هَٰذَا ٱلَّذِى هُوَ جُندٌۭ لَّكُمْ يَنصُرُكُم مِّن دُونِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ۚ إِنِ ٱلْكَٰفِرُونَ إِلَّا فِى غُرُورٍ EN: Or who is it that could be an army for you to aid you other than the Most Merciful?

entries.task_id: or who|is|it that could provide for you if he withheld his provision?
entries.description: Or who is it that could provide for you if He withheld His provision?
entries.subject: Or who
entries.object: it that could provide for you if He withheld His provision?

spans.text: [21] AR: أَمَّنْ هَٰذَا ٱلَّذِى يَرْزُقُكُمْ إِنْ أَمْسَكَ رِزْقَهُۥ ۚ بَل لَّجُّوا۟ فِى عُتُوٍّۢ وَنُفُورٍ EN: Or who is it that could provide for you if He withheld His provision?

entries.task_id: then|is|one who walks fallen on his face better guided or one who walks erect on a straight path?
entries.description: Then is one who walks fallen on his face better guided or one who walks erect on a straight path?
entries.subject: Then
entries.object: one who walks fallen on his face better guided or one who walks erect on a straight path?

spans.text: [22] AR: أَفَمَن يَمْشِى مُكِبًّا عَلَىٰ وَجْهِهِۦٓ أَهْدَىٰٓ أَمَّن يَمْشِى سَوِيًّا عَلَىٰ صِرَٰطٍۢ مُّسْتَقِيمٍۢ EN: Then is one who walks fallen on his face better guided or one who walks erect on a straight path?

entries.task_id: it|is|he who has produced you and made for you hearing and vision and hearts
entries.description: It is He who has produced you and made for you hearing and vision and hearts
entries.subject: It
entries.object: He who has produced you and made for you hearing and vision and hearts

spans.text: [23] AR: قُلْ هُوَ ٱلَّذِىٓ أَنشَأَكُمْ وَجَعَلَ لَكُمُ ٱلسَّمْعَ وَٱلْأَبْصَٰرَ وَٱلْأَفْـِٔدَةَ ۖ قَلِيلًۭا مَّا تَشْكُرُونَ EN: Say, "It is He who has produced you and made for you hearing and vision and hearts; little are you grateful."

entries.task_id: it|is|he who has multiplied you throughout the earth
entries.description: It is He who has multiplied you throughout the earth
entries.subject: It
entries.object: He who has multiplied you throughout the earth

spans.text: [24] AR: قُلْ هُوَ ٱلَّذِى ذَرَأَكُمْ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَإِلَيْهِ تُحْشَرُونَ EN: Say, "It is He who has multiplied you throughout the earth, and to Him you will be gathered."

entries.task_id: when|is|this promise
entries.description: When is this promise
entries.subject: When
entries.object: this promise

spans.text: [25] AR: وَيَقُولُونَ مَتَىٰ هَٰذَا ٱلْوَعْدُ إِن كُنتُمْ صَٰدِقِينَ EN: And they say, "When is this promise, if you should be truthful?"

entries.description: The knowledge is only with Allah
entries.subject: The knowledge
entries.object: only with Allah

spans.text: [26] AR: قُلْ إِنَّمَا ٱلْعِلْمُ عِندَ ٱللَّهِ وَإِنَّمَآ أَنَا۠ نَذِيرٌۭ مُّبِينٌۭ EN: Say, "The knowledge is only with Allah, and I am only a clear warner."

entries.task_id: this|is|that for which you used to call
entries.description: This is that for which you used to call
entries.subject: This
entries.object: that for which you used to call

spans.text: [27] AR: فَلَمَّا رَأَوْهُ زُلْفَةًۭ سِيٓـَٔتْ وُجُوهُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ وَقِيلَ هَٰذَا ٱلَّذِى كُنتُم بِهِۦ تَدَّعُونَ EN: But when they see it approaching, the faces of those who disbelieve will be distressed, and it will be said, "This is that for which you used to call."

entries.task_id: whether allah|should|cause my death and those with me or have mercy upon us
entries.description: whether Allah should cause my death and those with me or have mercy upon us
entries.subject: whether Allah
entries.object: cause my death and those with me or have mercy upon us

spans.text: [28] AR: قُلْ أَرَءَيْتُمْ إِنْ أَهْلَكَنِىَ ٱللَّهُ وَمَن مَّعِىَ أَوْ رَحِمَنَا فَمَن يُجِيرُ ٱلْكَٰفِرِينَ مِنْ عَذَابٍ أَلِيمٍۢ EN: Say, [O Muhammad], "Have you considered: whether Allah should cause my death and those with me or have mercy upon us, who can protect the disbelievers from a painful punishment?"

entries.description: He is the Most Merciful
entries.subject: He
entries.object: the Most Merciful

spans.text: [29] AR: قُلْ هُوَ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنُ ءَامَنَّا بِهِۦ وَعَلَيْهِ تَوَكَّلْنَا ۖ فَسَتَعْلَمُونَ مَنْ هُوَ فِى ضَلَٰلٍۢ مُّبِينٍۢ EN: Say, "He is the Most Merciful; we have believed in Him, and upon Him we have relied.

spans.text: [6] AR: وَلِلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ بِرَبِّهِمْ عَذَابُ جَهَنَّمَ ۖ وَبِئْسَ ٱلْمَصِيرُ EN: And for those who disbelieved in their Lord is the punishment of Hell, and wretched is the destination.

folded.id: their lord|unseen|will have forgiveness and great reward
folded.subject: their Lord
folded.object: will have forgiveness and great reward

spans.text: [12] AR: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ يَخْشَوْنَ رَبَّهُم بِٱلْغَيْبِ لَهُم مَّغْفِرَةٌۭ وَأَجْرٌۭ كَبِيرٌۭ EN: Indeed, those who fear their Lord unseen will have forgiveness and great reward.

folded.id: them what|is|thrown at the devils and have prepared for them the punishment of the blaze
folded.subject: them what
folded.object: thrown at the devils and have prepared for them the punishment of the Blaze

spans.text: [5] AR: وَلَقَدْ زَيَّنَّا ٱلسَّمَآءَ ٱلدُّنْيَا بِمَصَٰبِيحَ وَجَعَلْنَٰهَا رُجُومًۭا لِّلشَّيَٰطِينِ ۖ وَأَعْتَدْنَا لَهُمْ عَذَابَ ٱلسَّعِيرِ EN: And We have certainly beautified the nearest heaven with stars and have made [from] them what is thrown at the devils and have prepared for them the punishment of the Blaze.

folded.id: then|is|one who walks fallen on his face better guided or one who walks erect on a straight path?
folded.subject: Then
folded.object: one who walks fallen on his face better guided or one who walks erect on a straight path?

spans.text: [22] AR: أَفَمَن يَمْشِى مُكِبًّا عَلَىٰ وَجْهِهِۦٓ أَهْدَىٰٓ أَمَّن يَمْشِى سَوِيًّا عَلَىٰ صِرَٰطٍۢ مُّسْتَقِيمٍۢ EN: Then is one who walks fallen on his face better guided or one who walks erect on a straight path?

folded.id: this|is|that for which you used to call
folded.subject: This
folded.object: that for which you used to call

spans.text: [27] AR: فَلَمَّا رَأَوْهُ زُلْفَةًۭ سِيٓـَٔتْ وُجُوهُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ وَقِيلَ هَٰذَا ٱلَّذِى كُنتُم بِهِۦ تَدَّعُونَ EN: But when they see it approaching, the faces of those who disbelieve will be distressed, and it will be said, "This is that for which you used to call."

folded.id: when|is|this promise
folded.subject: When
folded.object: this promise

spans.text: [25] AR: وَيَقُولُونَ مَتَىٰ هَٰذَا ٱلْوَعْدُ إِن كُنتُمْ صَٰدِقِينَ EN: And they say, "When is this promise, if you should be truthful?"

folded.id: whether allah|should|cause my death and those with me or have mercy upon us
folded.subject: whether Allah
folded.object: cause my death and those with me or have mercy upon us

spans.text: [28] AR: قُلْ أَرَءَيْتُمْ إِنْ أَهْلَكَنِىَ ٱللَّهُ وَمَن مَّعِىَ أَوْ رَحِمَنَا فَمَن يُجِيرُ ٱلْكَٰفِرِينَ مِنْ عَذَابٍ أَلِيمٍۢ EN: Say, [O Muhammad], "Have you considered: whether Allah should cause my death and those with me or have mercy upon us, who can protect the disbelievers from a painful punishment?"

folded.id: while he|is|the subtle
folded.subject: while He
folded.object: the Subtle

spans.text: [14] AR: أَلَا يَعْلَمُ مَنْ خَلَقَ وَهُوَ ٱللَّطِيفُ ٱلْخَبِيرُ EN: Does He who created not know, while He is the Subtle, the Acquainted?

folded.id: while it|is|fatigued
folded.subject: while it
folded.object: fatigued

spans.text: [Your] vision will return to you humbled while it is fatigued.

folded.id: who it|is|that is in clear error
folded.subject: who it
folded.object: that is in clear error

spans.text: And you will [come to] know who it is that is in clear error."
